title: Modeling Annotator Disagreement with Demographic-Aware Experts and Synthetic Perspectives
reasoning: The paper focuses on architectural and data-centric methods for modeling annotator disagreement across demographic groups in subjective NLP tasks like toxicity and politeness. While it includes a standard Ethics section and deals with socially sensitive labels (Safety, Toxicity), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or formal ethical/moral systems.
